nodes.speaker: THE VOICE
nodes.text: You touch the Emerald Relic. A soft, soothing hum resonates through your fingertips.

nodes.speaker: THE VOICE
nodes.text: Does the sheer silence of this chamber calm your spirit, or does it disturb you?

nodes.speaker: THE VOICE
nodes.text: Peace is rare in these domains. Treasure this serenity before your next journey.

nodes.speaker: THE VOICE
nodes.text: Unnatural? Perhaps. But fear is merely an illusion cast by unfamiliar spaces.
